body.statement:
For every fixed known \((k,m)\) and \(\alpha\in(0,1)\), the corrected inverted set is uniformly honest,
\[
\inf_{\theta\in\mathcal M_{n,k,m}}
\Pr_\theta\{[h_\theta]\in\mathcal C_N(\alpha)\}
\ge1-\alpha-o(1).
\]
Define its representing-model diameter by
\[
\sup\left\{d_{\mathrm{rep}}(\vartheta,\vartheta'):
\vartheta,\vartheta'\in\mathcal M_{n,k,m},\
D_H(\vartheta,\widehat\theta_N)\vee
D_H(\vartheta',\widehat\theta_N)
\le2c_\alpha\rho_N+2\delta_N\right\}.
\]
The target asserts that this diameter is
\(O_{\mathbb P}\{\rho_N^{(k+1)/(k+m+1)}\}\).
body.justification: The confidence set expresses uncertainty in the identifiable quotient rather than in an arbitrary latent gauge.
body.gap: Manifold density bands cover the environment laws, while Bull--Nickl cover ordinary \(L^2\) function classes; neither propagates coverage through a critical nonlinear causal quotient.
body.consumer: Users can report uncertainty for recovered circular factors and compare representations without fixing an unidentifiable coordinate gauge.

obligation.what_is_open: The order-specific representation diameter of the honest inverted law set.
obligation.obstruction: Law-space coverage and law-space diameter do not imply the stated representation diameter until the full inverse-modulus upper bound is proved.
obligation.attempted: The missing factor two and deterministic-bias calibration were corrected, and uniform coverage was proved directly on the simultaneous spectral event.
obligation.partial_result: Uniform coverage is proved for the corrected radius \(2c_\alpha\rho_N+2\delta_N\). For any two models in that set, law-space triangle inequality gives complete-family Hellinger distance at most \(4c_\alpha\rho_N+4\delta_N\), but converting this to the claimed representation diameter is exactly the unresolved full-class inverse-modulus upper bound.
